name: Connichi
blurb: Germany's largest volunteer-run anime and manga convention, a fan-organised weekend of cosplay, concerts and Japanese culture in Wiesbaden.
notes: The most recent edition ran 4-6 September 2026, already over before this research window (starts 2026-10-05). As of this check, connichi.de itself (including its own 'Über die Connichi' opening-hours page) has not announced next year's dates; third-party aggregators (e.g. messen.de) list 3-5 September 2027 at the RheinMain CongressCenter (RMCC) Wiesbaden, but that is not yet confirmed on the organizer's own site, so no edition is listed.
